resources.string: AnyDeck Phone Records

Authorize usage and location records separately for sync with authorized ADB computers. Records stay on the phone for 7 days. Usage statistics may include pre-installation records and expanded system daily intervals.

Location records

Grant location access, then press Start. A persistent notification lets you stop anytime. Requests updates around every 5 minutes and 50 metres of movement; delivery depends on the system and signal. No automatic restart after stopping or rebooting.
